requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): studio_callback_tally@1 and studio_ordinal_majority@1 are the ONLY selectable scoring methods. Every other registry method (unavailable, rejected, draft) and every unknown key/version is refused (COMP_METHOD_UNKNOWN / COMP_ENGINE_NOT_AVAILABLE) with no fallback engine.
enforcement_point: Application: resolveMethod/selectableMethods/resolvePreset. Database: guard_competition_scoring_selection trigger (approved + engine only, unlocked draft only), competition_scoring_methods CHECK, apply_competition_scoring_setup, _compf2_engine_pin (selectable only).

tests.name: selectable set is exactly the two Studio methods
an explicit unavailable selection never falls back to a lower layer (legacy or division)
approves exactly the two studio methods

interpretation_notes: R-07(1). Verified at the application layer by executed tests and by static parity of the SQL seed rows. Application-layer behavior and static SQL parity are verified by EXECUTED tests (r07.failclosed.test.ts); the SQL runtime suites (sql-tests/test_T_competition_scoring_registry.sql, test_T_competition_e2_ballots.sql) were NOT RUN in this slice (heavy-lock queue), so the status stays unverified until their results are attached. Known gap in depth (F-2): the ballot format follows the legacy round.scoring_method while the engine follows the pin (override/division/legacy); SQL does not cross-check them, only the app readiness blocker COMP_SCORING_LEGACY_MISMATCH does.
